metadata.description: Anthropic University — an open, unofficial study hub for the Claude Certification program: an interactive exam runner, flashcard drilling, a docs-connected tutor, and a study coach. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or produced by Anthropic.

plugins.name: exam-prep
plugins.description: Sit a practice exam interactively, one question at a time — scored on the approximate 100–1000 scale (720 to pass) with a per-domain breakdown and a review of every miss.

plugins.name: study
plugins.description: Learn the material: read a track's study guide, get any concept explained with citations from the official Claude Code docs, and build a study roadmap around your weak areas.

plugins.name: flashcards
plugins.description: Spaced-repetition flashcard drilling in the terminal for any track — flip, self-grade, and focus on the cards you keep missing.

plugins.name: coach
plugins.description: Your certification coach: pinpoint weak domains, grade your written answers against the rubric, and get a day-by-day plan to exam day.

plugins.name: author
plugins.description: Maintainer toolkit for contributors: author new original questions to the schema, adversarially review a bank for accuracy and fairness, and rebuild all generated content.
